'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|You're finally in touch, mercenary. I was just approached by a man who calls himself a Master. He asked to find you, because from his words you understand the essence of the matter and deserve Their respect. The master asked me to tell you that there is a new job for you. It is necessary to eliminate experienced colleagues throughout Tarkov. I will give you the necessary equipment to complete the task. Let me be honest with you, my friend. I do not approve Master's methods, but the benefits offered are very attractive. I can't tell you everything, but I can give you some advice: special times are coming, save your ammunition if you want to survive. Our work with you is very productive, and I would not like you to die in this massacre.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 50 PMC operatives
* Hand over 50 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] level 25+ [[dogtags]]

==Rewards==
* 15,000 [[Dollars]]
** 15,750 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 17,250 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[T H I C C item case]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[4.6x30mm AP SX]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[5.45x39mm 7N40]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[5.56x45mm SSA AP]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[7.62x39mm MAI AP]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[7.62x51mm M993]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[9x19mm PBP gzh]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL1
{{Quote|Well, you completed the task, mercenary. The master has prepared an appropriate reward for you. Wait for a message, it seems that he is ready to offer a job in, so to speak, a specific place.}}
